Nuno Felix RT @kmathernova : A few moments ago, a russian drone exploded right above my head. I was just getting out of my armoured car into my hotel, together with Maya, my friend and colleague. My security officer Misha rushed me through the entrance door. Maya and I collapsed onto the sofa in the hotel atrium, literally shaking. We sat. A long while. A drone was shot down (the video captures the post impact) in the very center of Kyiv, just a short distance from the hotel where I’m staying. A friend managed to catch it on camera. russian forces have been attacking Kyiv relentlessly all day. Since midnight, I counted 34 air alerts! The Dutch embassy building and three other Embassies in Kyiv were also damaged! A 26-year-old man was killed and four others were injured in one of today’s attacks on Kyiv. That toll was reported just minutes ago and may still change. Several residential buildings were hit. Once again, civilians were the target. russia wants to make civilians pay for the damage Ukraine caused to the Kerch Bridge connecting russian occupied Crimea with mainland russia? We’re on our way to Lviv. I’m still catching my breath after that close call. Cherish what it means to live in peace, my friends. 🇪🇺 🤝 🇺🇦 tweet
